title: Zesty Silky Canadian Passion Fruit Pudding
description: A silky and salty Canadian dessert featuring passion fruit pulp, this crowd-pleaser is FODMAP-friendly and perfect for any occasion. It is made by simmering the ingredients together to create a smooth and creamy texture.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the passion fruit pulp, coconut milk, sugar, and salt.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the softened gelatin and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover it and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Once chilled, whip the mixture with an electric mixer until it becomes light and fluffy.
Spoon the pudding into individual serving cups and refrigerate for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or whipped cream if desired.
